q1.a: New groups open every month. Leave an application and a manager will tell you the nearest group and its exact start date.

q2.q: Is the trial lesson really free?
q2.a: Yes. The trial lesson is completely free and carries no obligation. You decide afterwards.

q3.a: Cash, card, bank transfer, and also Payme, Click and Uzum — you can pay directly from the personal cabinet.

q4.q: How do I follow my child's attendance?
q4.a: A separate cabinet opens for the parent with the attendance calendar, control-test results and payment history. If your child misses a lesson you receive a notification.

q5.q: How many students are in a group?
q5.a: Between 8 and 14 depending on the course. The speaking club is capped at 8.

q6.q: What happens if I miss a lesson?
q6.a: The absence is recorded in the system and visible in the cabinet. Excused absences are marked separately, and a catch-up session can be arranged with the teacher.

about.historyBody: Leader Learning Centre began in 2018 in a single room in Urgench. Today it is several branches, dozens of groups and new graduates every month — but the founding principle has not changed: give every student time.
about.missionBody: To give the young people of Khorezm language and mathematics education of an international standard without leaving home. The process must be fully transparent to student and parent alike.
